operation: Local deterministic RPC/wallet doubles and DOM tests for the paid on-chain inference browser flow
coverage: Exact 3811 logical-step upper count for prompt16/output32; per-logical calibrated reserve and separate hard reimbursement ceiling
All six runtime pins, immutable dependency/model/schema/domain/config/chain pins, and executor-only owner recovery
Captured Solidity EXTCODEHASH for nonexistent target, escrow separate from opening and recovery fee reserves
Immutable serialized quote binding; altered/stale quotes, active toJSON, wallet account/chain and late nonce/expiry races
Verified service identity/availability required before funding; accepted worker request never substituted for chain completion
Fresh bounded pre-send gas estimate and live Nitro transaction cap; job fee-ceiling clamp for paid manual actions
Durable pre-send wallet intent, unsent persistence-failure rollback, exact-hash ambiguity/restart recovery and duplicate-send prevention
Canonical receipt, exact transaction identity/calldata/value/nonce/gas/fees and pinned executor JobOpened event binding
Confirmed-storage rollback, actual funded job retained after service-trigger failure, no hidden wallet continuation loop
Strict terminal EOS and model word IDs, output token hash and exact codec bytes; report only for Completed jobs with text-safe rendering
Owner cancel/refund/withdraw after inference dependency pins break; expired top-up refusal and progress-tolerant owner cancellation

guards: Decode and return the internal retained quote after one caller serialization; read expiry/owner/chain from retained bytes
Bind production worker health to modelId as well as chainId and executor
Recheck final wallet balance after pending nonce lookup, preserving the separately quoted recovery reserve for opening
Roll back and best-effort persist an unsent pending intent if mandatory pre-send browser storage fails

independentRealModelIntegration.scope: Separate local real-model proof; retain its explicit owner-refund receipt retention limitation

operationalLimitations: Calibrated funding is an operational estimate. Longer attention positions are explicitly extrapolated; a job may pause for price, deadline or budget and require reviewed top-up/cancellation.
Production funding remains disabled until the actual continuation service returns verified ready health; these local doubles do not establish hosting or signer availability.
An underfunded wallet may receive the RPC insufficient-funds estimate error before total affordability can be displayed; no funding transaction is requested.
Production calibration must bind the deployed modelId while retaining the local source modelId as provenance, because model identity includes deployed shard addresses.
